title: Foundation
description: Urja Foods was established with a foundational vision for healthier tomorrows, focusing on sustainable agro-practices, grain processing, and empowering rural farming communities.

title: First Facility
description: Set up our first manufacturing unit to ensure quality and consistency. This facility marked the beginning of our journey towards delivering healthier food products.

title: Growing Team
description: Built a strong team of passionate individuals committed to our shared mission of nutritional excellence, farmer welfare, and sustainable growth.

title: Market Expansion
description: Expanded to new regions and distribution networks, reaching more customers and agricultural partners with dependable, quality agro-nutrition products.

title: Strategic Partnerships
description: Collaborated with trusted industry partners and contract farming networks to enhance our capabilities and integrate the supply chain.

title: Sustainability Focus
description: Led eco-friendly initiatives including 1.2 MW captive solar power across operations, closed-loop water management, and an ambitious tree plantation pledge.

title: Recognition
description: Received industry recognition and prestigious bio-security certifications for uncompromising standards in feed manufacturing, hygiene, and product safety.

title: A Healthier Tomorrow
description: Continuing our forward journey towards a healthier and stronger world through modern, sustainable farm-to-fork agribusiness and nutritional innovations.
